business.description: The Andhra Sugars Limited operates in the chlor-alkali and chemicals sector, manufacturing caustic soda, sulphuric acid, and other chemicals. The company has permanently closed its sugar units at Tanuku, Taduvai, and Bhimadole, and operates captive power plants including coal, solar, and wind power.

Initially when Unit-1 (Tanuku) was setup cane was supplied from the Delta Area around Tanuku which had a rotational 2nd Crop But after the Godavari Barrage was built the Delta Area was converted to continuous 2nd Crop causing a Drop in cane Growing Area resulting in Uneconomic Quantity of Cane Supply. So, Unit-1 at Tanuku was permanently closed. Unit-2 (Taduvai) was basically a Tobacco Growing Area. But when Black soil Tobacco Exports Ceased Farmers swiched to Cane Growing due to which we setup our Unit -2 at Taduvai. For past few seasons due to a shortage of Tobacco, Rates Shot-up causing Farmers Switching back to Tobacco resulting in Cane Supply drop-

The company proposes for sourcing up of renewable energy like Solar, Green Hydrogen etc. that will help in reducing Green House Gases (GHG) emissions. Initially because of higher Capex, this will be negative but in medium to long term it will be positive.

Continuous drop in the availability of Sugar Cane. Inspite of various approaches to mitigate this risk, still plantation levels are not encouraging. This might be negative in the Medium Term/ Long Term.

To effectively manage the risks associated with energy management, the company is undertaking Energy Efficiency efforts, reducing reliance on non-renewable energy sources, and Renewable Energy Integration. Adopting energy-efficient practices and integrating renewable energy sources can result in cost savings over the long term.

To address the risks associated with volatile market trends, the company is implementing Diversification of Customer Base and to enhance supply chain resilience and exploring various possibilities for reducing costs of Key elements such as power etc. and investing continuously in Technology advancement.
For medium to long term, CSR spending on development of Education and Health Care will be positive.
